tickets.title: Complete address and residency update workflow
tickets.text: Use this workflow when Elena Pippinwisp and Rowan Pippinwisp report a new mailing address, tax residency change, seasonal residence, or household relocation. Confirm the effective date, update advisory records, and identify planning consequences for tax-aware investment management, retirement income distributions, and account communications. Update the address, statement delivery preferences, and planning assumptions for the new Reno residence and tax-residency trail after the move from Oregon.

subTasks.title: Confirm move details and documentation
subTasks.text: Collect the new mailing address, physical residence, prior address, effective date, seasonal residence notes, and any supporting documentation Elena and Rowan are comfortable providing.

subTasks.title: Update internal records and communication preferences
subTasks.text: Update CRM, household profile, statement delivery preferences, meeting location notes, and any compliance-required address fields.

subTasks.title: Review planning impacts
subTasks.text: Check whether the move affects state tax assumptions, retirement distribution withholding, municipal bond exposure, estate document jurisdiction, insurance coverage, or advisor registration requirements.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion with client
subTasks.text: Send a brief confirmation summarizing the updates made and any follow-up items Elena and Rowan should address with tax, legal, or account providers.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for 2024-09-03 is to update the address, statement delivery preferences, and planning assumptions for the new residence and tax-residency trail.

tickets.title: Request and organize estate document copies
tickets.text: Ask Elena Pippinwisp and Rowan Pippinwisp to provide current copies of core estate documents, including will, revocable trust if applicable, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designations, trustee or executor contact information, and any recent amendment pages. Store received documents according to firm procedures and note missing items for follow-up. Note that the 2018 estate plan drafted by attorney Nadia Cloudpuddle of Buttonwood Balloon Legal includes a revocable trust structure, and the planning file lacks current copies of the will, trust amendment pages, powers of attorney, health care directive, and beneficiary-designation confirmations.
tickets.evidence: The unresolved estate-binder follow-up dated 2024-09-20 is collection of those current documents and confirmations.

tickets.title: Review equity award evidence and planning criteria
tickets.text:
Collect and review:
- Current equity award statement or portal export.
- Grant agreements and plan documents for each award type.
- Vesting schedule, expiration dates, blackout windows, and trading policy limits.
- Option type, strike price, current estimated value, and exercise rules.
- RSU release schedule, withholding method, and sell-to-cover details.
- ESPP purchase periods, discount, holding period rules, and payroll contribution rate.
- Concentration exposure compared with total household net worth and investable assets.
- Tax evidence needed for ordinary income, AMT, capital gains, and estimated payments.
- Employment status risks, change-in-control provisions, and post-termination exercise windows.
- Elena Pippinwisp's goals for diversification, cash needs, charitable giving, and retirement income.

Flag missing evidence, conflicts between documents, tax questions for the CPA, and transactions requiring pre-clearance before any recommendation is finalized. Review the Cloudberry Kite Robotics portal materials together, including restricted stock units, incentive stock options, and blackout-window notices, given the large share of household investable wealth the equity represents.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for 2024-09-13 is to review those employer-equity materials together.

tickets.title: Coordinate estimated tax reserves with CPA Jasper Thimblefern
tickets.text: Coordinate with CPA Jasper Thimblefern of Silver Marmot Tax on estimated tax reserves for Elena Pippinwisp and Rowan Pippinwisp before any employer-share sale or option exercise is modeled for cash-flow planning.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for 2024-09-18 is coordination on those estimated tax reserves.

tickets.title: Year-End Deadline Sweep
tickets.text: Review year-end charitable transfer timing for Elena Pippinwisp and Rowan Pippinwisp, using appreciated taxable holdings alongside their cash-gift pattern and tax projections. Their 2023 charitable giving was about $22,000, primarily cash gifts to Pocket Lantern Foundation and a local food bank.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for 2024-11-15 is to review year-end charitable transfer timing with their cash-gift pattern and tax projections.
